saving.title: Saving project…
saving.detail: Please wait while your changes are saved.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.detail: Your local changes will be lost.

conflict.title: Project changed on the server
conflict.detail: A newer version of this project exists. Your local changes are still available, but they cannot be saved over the newer version.
conflict.confirmDetail: Reloading the latest server version will permanently discard your unsaved local changes.

refresh.latestTitle: The latest project could not be loaded
refresh.latestDetail: Your local changes were discarded, but the authoritative Project and Geometry data could not be refreshed.
